title: Avoid trigram text type uppercase allocation
description: Replace indexed trigram text column detection's to_ascii_uppercase allocation with ASCII case-insensitive helpers.

criteria: Indexed trigram text column detection no longer allocates uppercase data type strings
TEXT, STRING, VARCHAR, CHAR, VARCHAR(...), CHAR(...), and CHARACTER... remain recognized
Index-type filtering remains limited to BTree and FTS indexed text columns
Focused helper and column-filter tests pass

notes: The helper trims the data type and uses ASCII case-insensitive comparisons and prefix checks.
indexed_trigram_text_columns still preserves the existing index-type and is_indexed filters.
Trigram index update and row-id logic are unchanged.
